title: Guilds/Team
description: This project adds the Guilds/Team Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin focusing on interactive GUI menus, advanced streamer-safe waypoints, and shared double-chest vaults.
body:
🛡️ GUILDS/TEAMS

Guilds/Teams is a comprehensive, feature-rich team management plugin designed for Spigot & Paper Minecraft servers. Focusing on a completely visual and interactive interface, players and administrators can manage guilds, members, and configurations through custom-designed GUI menus—minimizing the need for complex chat commands.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

🌟 KEY FEATURES

[Player Experience]

• Interactive Dashboard Menu (/team) Opens a color-coded stained glass GUI to create teams, view invites, or manage your guild dashboard.

• Private Chat Channel (/tc) Send private team messages with clean, formatted prefixes: [Team] [Rank] Player: Message.

• Action-Bar Waypoint HUD Renders a size-aligned compass HUD pointer (using fallback unicode arrows for identical straight/diagonal scaling).

• Streamer-Safe Coordinates Protection Instantly hides the waypoint HUD and masks base coordinates and dimension names in all menus and commands.

[Team Collaboration]

• Dynamic Shared Vault A shared chest vault that grows progressively from 9 to 54 slots (double chest) as the team levels up.

• GUI Teammate Teleportation Click player heads in a visual menu to teleport directly to teammates, balanced with warmup and cooldown timers.

• Proximity Buffs & Team XP Earn guild XP from mining and combat. Stand near teammates (within 15 blocks) to receive Regeneration and Haste buffs.

• XP Action Bar Priority Gaining team XP blocks the waypoint HUD for 3 seconds to keep leveling alerts fully visible.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

🛠️ COMMANDS & PERMISSIONS

[Player Commands]

• /team Opens the main team dashboard GUI menu. (Aliases: /t, /guild, /g)

• /team vault Directly opens the shared team chest vault.

• /team chat [message] Toggles private chat mode, or sends a quick message. (Alias: /team c)

• /team tp Opens teammate teleportation GUI menu. (Alias: /team teleport)

• /team streamermode [on/off] Toggles streamer-safe coordinates protection. (Alias: /team streamer)

• /team waypoint [on/off] Toggles action-bar waypoint pointer visibility. (Alias: /team hud)

• /team setbase Sets the team base waypoint at your location. (Officers/Leaders only)

• /team clearbase Clears the permanent team base waypoint. (Officers/Leaders only)

• /team friendlyfire Toggles friendly fire damage between teammates. (Alias: /team ff | Leader only)

• /team invite [player] Invites a player to join your team. (Officers/Leaders only)

• /team join [team] Joins a team from a pending invitation. (Alias: /team accept)

• /team leave Leaves your current team. Disbands team if leader is last member.

• /tc [message] Sends a message directly to the team chat channel.

[Admin Commands]

• /teamadmin Opens the Master Admin configuration GUI menu. (Aliases: /ta, /guildadmin, /ga | Permission: guilds.admin)

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

👑 MASTER ADMIN CONTROL (/teamadmin)

Administrators can customize the plugin settings in real-time using a clean, symmetric control panel:

• Dynamic Economy Connection Connect dynamically to any economy plugin (Vault, PlayerPoints, Essentials) via chat prompts.

• Creation Cost Types & Amounts Toggle cost types (FREE, XP, ECONOMY, VANILLA_ITEM, CUSTOM_ITEM) and modify cost values.

• Item Template Selector Hold any item in your main hand and click to set it as the cost template for team creation.

• Symmetric Command Editor Paginated 3-page editor to manage general dashboard command aliases, chat aliases, and custom sub-feature mappings.

• Limits & Global Toggles Adjust member limits, server-wide team limits, reload settings, and toggle teleportation, vaults, and buffs server-wide.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

⚙️ REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY

• Platform: Paper or Spigot 1.20.x or 1.21.x

• Java Version: Java 17 or 21 (Depending on your Spigot/Paper server version)

• Optional Hooks: Any economy plugin (Vault, PlayerPoints, Essentials, etc.) for dynamic cost hook.
